query:
SELECT  ' [[Datei:item_' || items.name || '.png|zentriert|frameless|64x64px]]' AS Bild, 
  items.name AS Name, items.name AS ID,  
  '#Lang#item.' || items.name || '.desc' AS Beschreibung, 
  stacksize AS Stapelgrösse, 
  "group" AS Gruppe, 
  items.type AS Typ 
  FROM items 
  WHERE  items.name NOT NULL  AND "group" NOT NULL  AND items.assetpath NOT NULL 
   AND "group"='Cloth'
   order by name
